Synopsis:
Germany is moving to formally attribute a drone-bomb incident at Leipzig/Halle airport (a key NATO logistics and Ukrainian cargo hub) to Russia, and is coordinating with allies on potential new sanctions. Senior officials stopped short of full confirmation but signalled a firm response. The incident is framed as part of a broader Russian hybrid/sabotage campaign against Europe. Attribution and sanctions escalation are imminent.
